description: JRC-EU-TIMES Building Stock Module is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Nijs Wouter (European Commission Joint Research Centre). This Excel file includes a geometry based calibration of the EU building stock for the year 2010 and is one of the building blocks of JRC-EU-TIMES. Associated datasets of JRC-EU-TIMES are made open as separate data sources for non-TIMES users. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2019. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
